action: Ipsos clients: no action required yet. You may ask your account contact whether the affected system held your data, and watch for an official update.
exec: A limited intrusion at a global research firm that holds client and survey data; no data loss figures have been given.
plain: Market research company Ipsos said on November 16 that intruders got into one of its internal systems. It reported no effect on its operations and has filed a complaint with the authorities.
summary: The market research group said on November 16 that intruders got into one internal system, with no impact on operations, and that it filed a complaint with authorities. No data volumes or attacker have been named.
title: Ipsos says hackers accessed one internal system

validation.note: Two secondary write-ups read as excerpts; the company statement was not read.
